latest_release.body:
## ver. 1.1.1 (2026/08/15) - triple one win

Update of fail2ban.

See the [ChangeLog](https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban/blob/1.1.1/ChangeLog) for more information.

**All changes**: https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban/compare/1.1.0...1.1.1

It also includes debian package, built without a test suite (fail2ban-testcases, fail2ban.test python module).
This will also install systemd managed fail2ban.socket now (gh-4220).
**UPD.** deb-package `fail2ban_1.1.1-1.upstream1_all.deb` got wrong paths (due to missing dependency of systemd-dev
in build system, gh-4222), so it is removed and replaced with [fail2ban_1.1.1-1.upstream2_all.deb](https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban/releases/download/1.1.1/fail2ban_1.1.1-1.upstream2_all.deb) now.

Sincere thanks to everyone who helped!
